Partial credit. The response does front-load diagnosis: §0 challenges the brief ('treats symptom as if it were the diagnosis', warns about no counterfactual and learning reset), and §1 'Diagnose before building (Days 1–3)' proposes a real per-concept triage on frequency, CPM, CTR, hook rate, CPA and spend share, with a tier table (🟢 keep-live / 🟠 fatigued winner / 🔴 dead weight) and per-tier actions including 'Do NOT touch yet' and 'Kill immediately, don't bother refreshing'. That is genuine per-creative scoping.
